archetype: ARCHETYPE 2 & 4 FUSION - Performance Pro & Swiss High-Contrast for Italian Culinary SaaS

logo_spec.rendering_note: Dark navy rounded box (#141D2C) containing the coral-red stylized 'B' icon (#F5595A). Fits restaurant login app icon branding.

colors.guidance: Eliminated green #2d5a27 and orange #c4501c to eliminate visual overlap with tiptii. Anchor brand identity with Coral Red #F5595A from the Bancomanda 'B' app logo, contrasting against Deep Navy #141D2C (derived from the restaurant iPad login panel). Use Deep Navy #141D2C for high-impact bands and primary cards.

layouts.landing: Fixed blur header, responsive hero grid with floating status cards, bento grid for feature storytelling with real kitchen photos, dark navy contrast band for live order flow, iPad app showcase gallery, photo demo section, FAQ accordion, and dual-column footer.
layouts.admin_dashboard: Dark navy / elevated white sidebar with brand badge, top stat cards grid with status icons, tabbed tenant data table with status pills and action buttons, superadmin login screen.

buttons.btn-primary: background: #F5595A, color: #FFFFFF, box-shadow: 0 10px 25px -5px rgba(245, 89, 90, 0.35); hover: translateY(-2px), background: #E04849.
buttons.btn-outline: background: transparent, border: 1px solid #E2E8F0, color: #0F172A; hover: border #F5595A, color #F5595A, bg #F2F0EB.
buttons.btn-login: background: rgba(245, 89, 90, 0.12), color: #F5595A; hover: background #F5595A, color #FFFFFF.

motion.scroll: Lenis smooth scroll feel / IntersectionObserver scroll reveal fade-in-up.
motion.cards: Subtle 8px translateY on hover with expanded shadow rgba(245, 89, 90, 0.15).

accessibility.contrast: APCA & WCAG AA compliant. Minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio for all body text over light or dark backgrounds.
accessibility.reduced_motion: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) disables CSS keyframe transforms and transitions.

instructions_to_main_agent: Replace existing green/orange CSS variables in /app/backend/routes/landing.py and /app/backend/routes/admin_dashboard.py with the new Coral Red (#F5595A) and Dark Navy (#141D2C) palette.
Update the .logo-icon CSS class to use background #141D2C with text color #F5595A (or linear-gradient from #141D2C to #1A202C with coral-red 'B' letter).
Ensure all interactive CTA buttons use the red #F5595A primary brand color.
Preserve all existing HTML structural layout, JavaScript API integrations, and data-testid attributes.
